comment: TimeSplitters 2 PAL: the character roster with 32 spare slots (127-158), for characters a mod adds (ts2/characters.ini). Written by tools/ts2_roster_patches.py; docs/formats/roster.md, 'Room for more characters', says why each site changes. sub_0008FAE0's search (0x0008FB6E) keeps its 127: recomp_manual.c covers it. Then 60 ticks a second, as the USA release has, where the PAL release turned seconds into ticks with 50 (366 sites, 'tick rate:'; tools/ts2_tick_rate.py).

operations.why: the roster with 32 spare slots (159 entries and a sentinel) at +0, its unlock snapshot at +0x1400, the texture list with 32 more entries at +0x1800
the disc's 127 roster entries, in their order
spare slots 127-158: the Consultant's entry (chr id 92, gangster background, unlock kind 0 'never', so hidden everywhere), each with a portrait of its own, texture 548-579
the sentinel after the last slot: chr id -1, where the four chr id searches below now stop
the disc's 548 texture list entries: how to load (+0), load flags (+4), path (+8), handle (+0xC)
the spare slots' portraits, texture 548-579: the Consultant's path (ped3) with load flags 0, which no level loads; a mod's ts2/characters.ini gives each its own file and the Consultant's flags
